scripts.check:deps: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const bad=['dependencies','devDependencies','peerDependencies','optionalDependencies'].flatMap((t)=>Object.keys(p[t]||{})).filter((n)=>/^(matterbridge|@matterbridge|@matter|@project-chip)/.test(n));if(bad.length){console.error('Matterbridge refuses plugins that list: '+bad.join(', ')+'. Use npm run dev:matterbridge instead.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: node -e "for (const p of ['dist','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.prepack: npm run check:deps && npm run lint && npm run build
